costs.label: Amazon S3 (us-east-2)
costs.model: $0.023/GB-month, $0.005 per 1k writes, $0.0004 per 1k reads, egress $0.09/GB after 100 GB/month free (then $0.085, $0.07 tiers)
costs.source: https://aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing/ (storage, requests, and data transfer tabs, US East (Ohio)); same values in the AWS Price List API, AmazonS3 and AWSDataTransfer offers

costs.label: Cloudflare R2
costs.model: $0.015/GB-month after 10 GB free, $4.50 per 1M writes after 1M, $0.36 per 1M reads after 10M, egress free

costs.label: Railway Buckets
costs.model: $0.015/GB-month, requests and egress free. The Free plan covers up to 10 GB-month with its $1 monthly credit; Hobby ($5/month, counted toward usage) caps storage at 1 TB; Pro ($20/month, counted toward usage) has no cap. This assumes uploads go straight to the bucket; uploads sent through a Railway service are billed as service egress at $0.05/GB (railway.com/pricing), since buckets are not on the private network yet

costs.label: Backblaze B2
costs.model: $6.95/TB-month after 10 GB free, class A/B/C requests free, egress free up to 3x stored then $0.01/GB

costs.label: Neon (Launch plan)
costs.model: $0.023/GB-month, requests free, 500 GB/month egress per project then $0.10/GB (shared with Postgres traffic)

costs.label: Bunny Storage (Standard, 1 region)
costs.model: $0.01/GB-month, requests and API egress free, $1 monthly minimum. Bunny's pricing assumes files are served through Bunny CDN, so egress is priced at its Europe and North America CDN rate of $0.01/GB

costs.label: Appwrite (Pro plan)
costs.model: $25/month per project with 150 GB storage and 2 TB bandwidth, then $2.80 per 100 GB stored and $15 per 100 GB served; file operations are not billed per request

costs.label: Convex (Professional, 1 developer)
costs.model: $25 per developer per month with 100 GB file storage, 50 GB egress, and 25M function calls, then $0.03/GB stored, $0.12/GB served, and $2 per 1M calls. Each upload costs one function call to mint its upload URL; reads from file URLs are not function calls

costs.label: Upstash Blob (pay as you go)
costs.model: $0.02/GB-month, $4.50 per 1M writes, $0.30 per 1M reads, egress free up to 1 TB/month then $0.02/GB

costs.label: Tigris (Standard)
costs.model: $0.02/GB-month after 5 GB free (billed in binary GB, like S3), $0.005 per 1k writes after 10k, $0.0005 per 1k reads after 100k, egress free
